title: Fix configured AI provider start-analysis gate

commits.message: fix: restore configured AI provider start availability

user_summary: AI服务已配置且模式可选时，开始分析仍误报当前AI服务不支持此分析，导致无法启动分析。
technical_summary: Settings validation_snapshot success was ignored by start gate when latest ModelInvocation was cached_failure; frontend collapsed all blockers to 当前AI服务不支持此分析. Fix: durable snapshot overrides stale cached_failure in provider_eligibility; AnalysisExecutionPlan SSOT endpoint; StartAnalysisDialog gates on plan.can_start with differentiated reasons; refresh invalidates analysis-execution-plan.
acceptance_criteria: Verified Settings snapshot + configured plus can_start true for FAST/BALANCED/QUALITY/CUSTOM
Stale cached_failure alone no longer blocks when validation snapshot matches
Start button uses ExecutionPlan.can_start; refresh invalidates plan queries; no blanket 不支持此分析
verification_evidence: 1.0.4 install manual: AI configured, modes selectable, consent checked, start disabled with 当前AI服务不支持此分析; tech details showed aliyun_qwen_plus unhealthy cached_failure provider_unhealthy while max/flash expected unsupported.
Root cause: start gate used provider list manual_boundary_candidate_eligible filtered by cached_failure; Settings READY used ai_service_validation_snapshot that did not clear that failure.

Coverage: execution-plan pytest (8) + StartAnalysisDialog/providerEligibility/aiServiceViewModel vitest (50); production packaged and browser_local_production share same backend evaluate_manual_boundary_candidate + execution plan (no data-dir/credential-key changes).
